description: Election Commission -  Mr. B. Muralitharan of the Koralaipattu North Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office Member
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct matter related to electoral processes and the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
